terms.operative: The type of a glossary term's focus when it is an organization (folio-glossary/v1 `focus.type`), emitted by the content core's schemas/glossary.ts#toSkos. The concept is the word; the organization is the body of people (owner, 2026-10-31, option B: SKOS + W3C ORG).
A focus type: a legally recognised organization, such as a statutory health professional council.
A focus type: a part of a larger organization.
A focus type: a collaboration between organizations.
A focus's `subOrganizationOf`: the parent organization, a local term id or an absolute IRI.
